best_supported_conclusion: Pines remains a plausible family-use and retention research lead. Continued transactions and school context support relevance, not a guaranteed floor, causal management premium or a validated acquisition discount.

unknowns.consequence: Decision-changing now for subject G0 reference

sequential_dispositions.G0: STOP: subject normalisation unresolved, not simply a missing full purchase file
sequential_dispositions.G1-G4: Mechanism, household task and quality research retained as hypotheses; no formal pass while G0 unresolved
sequential_dispositions.G6-G8: Conditional finance/exit diagnostics only; no admitted buyer-depth, lending or allocation conclusion

hypotheses.floor: Family/community utility may retain a viable buyer pool and reduce obsolescence risk; it does not guarantee an absolute sale-price minimum.
hypotheses.premium: A premium requires matched evidence of greater willingness to pay after condition/rights/cost differences; not established.
hypotheses.retention: Repeat whole-household tenancy may reduce turnover drag; no observed retention rate adopted.

divergence.reason: The approved judgment distinguishes demand support from appreciation. Negative full-cost carry does not contradict residential utility. Do not convert absence of premium evidence into negative evidence on management.

investigation.data_limitation: Area labels, mixtures, unexplained high trades, incomplete time coverage and asking rents may distort interpretation.
investigation.judgment_bias: Avoid selecting only low acquisition/high rent/high exit observations to justify the preferred family project.
investigation.omitted_variable: Refurbishment, stack/exposure, parking and household fit may explain prices and retention.
investigation.structural_change: Management changes, funded renewals or future competition could alter outcomes; no future uplift assumed.

divergence.falsification: Withdraw any premium thesis if matched transactions show no durable premium after costs, or retention/collection and funded upkeep fail the expected advantage.

misses.finding: Filtered cohort evidence adds useful observations to prior mixed-summary research. No full-file demand should replace the actual normalisation question.
A furnished acquisition may need less than default5% fit-out. Zero-additional-fit-out lower-bound diagnostics are included, without adopting zero cost or changing SOP.

next: R231 Zeva versus KV14 Solstice: separate investor-exit depth and daily-use location support from assumed price appreciation. For Pines, reopen on actual normalisation/retention/funding evidence rather than another unchanged broad search.
